key_factors: Precision machining of raw castings and complex multi-line assembly of internal pumping components

key_factors: LED module blocks (containing LED modules and PCBAs)

key_factors: Stainless-steel q-bolt and t-bolt striker pin

key_factors: The Electronic Speed Controller (ESC) Board and Main PCBA subassemblies

key_factors: The unitary plastic seat foundation and backrest shell

key_factors: Flow forming and extensive machining of the forged aluminum blank into a finished wheel

key_factors: Pre-manufactured Chinese lamp components (metal housing, socket, light bulb, glass lens)

key_factors: The LCD panel combined with the final assembly and PCBA production in China

key_factors: Fabrication of key components (magnetron, PCBA, structural metal and plastic parts) and complex assembly into a finished microwave oven
decisive_step: Stamping metal parts, injection molding plastics, SMT production of PCBAs, manufacturing the magnetron, and final assembly in Thailand
